verdict.reasons: The image contains the correct family (tape20) with authentic AFP branding and the required legitimate watermark, but it fundamentally fails core editorial and technical constraints by explicitly using the packaging as operating plumbing (the pressure gauge and tape connection are physically installed on the sealed packaging label). This violates the requirement to not use the package as hardware and creates an implausible irrigation geometry. Furthermore, the specific requested installed lateral evidence is missing, instead showing loose flat tape, and the secondary packaging text is nonsensical. These represent core defects that make the image unsuitable.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
